Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Forest Moments expanded FOUR-ISLAND archipelago overall environment concept, painterly mature warm storybook PC game, not a screenshot.
Create a wide panoramic elevated oblique aerial view of EXACTLY FOUR distinct islands, all fully inside frame with ocean margin and clear water channels between them. The LARGE MAIN ISLAND fills the LEFT half to two-thirds: broad western extension covered in genuinely DENSE deep evergreen mixed forest, touching overlapping crowns of pines and slender pointed spruces, scattered pale-barked birches, occasional broadleaf crowns, only a few small sunlit gaps and thin trails partly hidden under canopy. Trees in groups, layered ages, not isolated trees on lawn. Existing very small southern life clearing has one modest wooden workshop, tiny fenced farm, freshwater pond, southern sandy beach, north cliff wooden lookout, and east-facing jetty. Buildings sparse, trees dominant.
THREE SMALLER NEIGHBOR ISLANDS clearly separated to the RIGHT, arranged in a loose triangular vertical chain: TOP-RIGHT MIST PINE ISLAND, densely wooded dark pine/spruce with a little thin mist and west-facing dock; MIDDLE-RIGHT AUTUMN GROVE ISLAND, birch and maple groves in muted golden ochre and russet autumn foliage mixed with dark evergreen pine, rolling woodland path and southwest-facing dock; LOWER-RIGHT / lower-middle TIDEPOOL ISLAND, the smallest and lowest, warm-grey natural rock coast, visible shallow still tidal pools, a few windswept leaning pines with asymmetric umbrella crowns, sparse coastal grass, clear dry shoreline path, northwest-facing sheltered dock. Each neighbor around one fifth the main island's land area or smaller. Main island remains clearly largest. All four docks serve navigable channels. ONE tiny canoe between main island and neighbors. No other landmasses, tiny islets, bridges or distant islands. Three neighbors have NO buildings.
Style: restrained warm storybook hand-painted concept, sculpted readable forms, textured matte bark, foliage masses, natural grey rocks, muted teal sea, soft amber late afternoon sunlight and rich soft forest shade. Not photoreal aerial photo, toy plastic, voxel or a theme park. Seasonal autumn colors concentrated in deciduous trees; conifers stay green. Show dense forest rather than many grassy holes. Preserve complete silhouettes and enough water around every island, full landscape panoramic composition. No text, labels, numbers, UI, icons, logos, borders or watermark. This is a mood/spatial proposal, not a cartographic map.

One very small raccoon seen from behind far enough along the trail to establish scale, subtle not a cartoon face portrait. No buildings, lamps, bridges, settlements or ocean in this forest view.
Tree silhouettes must vary: spreading ancient pine, narrow conical spruce, delicate branching birch, mixed age understory. Calm inviting shade, dark muted forest greens #28453A, warm brown bark, amber dappled highlights, restrained painterly texture, soft sculpted game-art forms. Dense and enveloping but readable, not a horror forest, not black fog, no shiny plastic, not photoreal. Wide landscape view, single coherent scene, no inset panel, labels, text, watermark or UI. This illustrates the desired canopy/midstory/understory layers, not current game output.
